description:
Swamp Thing #8, #11 and #12 (December 2000 - April 2001), DC/Vertigo - Brian K. Vaughan's run, starring Tefe Holland. Suggested for mature readers. Direct sales, $2.50 cover price each.

- #8: Vaughan, Petersen, Magyar. Back cover: Warner Bros. Gotham Girls / Lobo webisodes ad
- #11: Glenn Fabry painted cover; Vaughan, Petersen, Magyar. Back cover: Wizard World "What's It Worth?" ad
- #12: Red Harvest part 2, The Stockholm Syndrome. Glenn Fabry painted cover; Vaughan, Camuncoli, Magyar. Back cover: Bose Wave radio/CD ad

Condition: all three bright with light handling wear; #12 has a small nick at the bottom edge of the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
